'''''Nanda's Luck''''' was the fishing vessel of the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bipopa Bogzider]].<ref name="Ando" />

[[Sissalik]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamarian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], joined ''Nanda's Luck''{{'s}} crew shortly after he had poisoned and killed his enslaver [[Farvakine]], then escaping from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During their 99th day on sea, ''Nanda's Luck'' was attacked by the [[Majestic (pirate ship)|''Majestic'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Pyash Yopayomba]], the [[Pirate queen of Ando|Pirate Queen of Ando]]. After a short [[Skirmish aboard the Nanda's Luck|skirmish]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] emerged victorious with Yopayomba killing Bogzider and appointing Sissalik as the new Captain of ''Nanda's Luck''.<ref name="Ando" />

The ship's cargo of [[Andoan mineral-fish]] shells were replaced with explosives. Yopayomba's plan was to ram the [[Quantill City harbor]] terminal port, thereby possibly taking out a good portion of the city filled with revelers of the [[Portage Moon Festival]]. Pre-planted evidence would then place the blame on racist [[Aquala/Legends|Aquala]] extremists, which would start a planetary civil war, benefiting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In exchange for her help in the plot, Yopayomba was to be given complete control of Ando's oceans.<ref name="Ando" />

However, Sissalik took control of the ship through the manual bridge controls. He left his journal log in a [[Aquala cuttlewine]] bottle with an open [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] before ramming ''Nanda's Luck'' straight to the ''Majestic''.<ref name="Ando" />
